programme.title: SAMURAI MARATHON [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In 1855, a daimyo sends his men on a grueling marathon to discover if they're tough enough to face the newly arrived Americans. Misunderstanding his intent, the Shogun dispatches assassins.

programme.title: 11 REBELS [English Dub]
programme.desc: Amidst the Boshin War's brutal conflicts, a motley squad of criminals and samurai undertakes a desperate defense of a fortress, their stand triggered by clashing interests of the Shibata clan, the shogunate, and the new government.

programme.title: GINTAMA [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In an era where aliens have invaded and conquered feudal Tokyo, a young samurai seeks work as he can.

programme.title: Inside Men [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A politician and a wealthy CEO scheme with a reputable journalist to create slush fund and to manipulate public opinion. They use Ahn Sang-gu, a gangster deeply involved in politics, to manage their slush fund, but Ahn Sang-gu gets caught and as a result is abandoned. Sang-gu is bent on having his revenge. On the other hand, Woo Jang-hoon, a prosecutor without any powerful friends, is desperate to solve the slush fund case so he can get a promotion.

programme.title: The Man Standing Next [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: October 26th, 1979, Kim Gyu-pyeong, the director of KCIA, shoots President Park at his safe house. Forty days before the incident, Park Yong-gak, the former KCIA director, disclose the president's corruption. The Pres. wants to "take care of" Park after discovering he wrote a memoir, and Kim volunteers to persuade him. Kim asks Park to hand over the documents and asks forgiveness, but Park refuses, saying, "He doesn't let the No. 2 alive." Kwak Sang-chun, the head of the president's security team, expresses his loyalty to the president excessively, which makes the conflict between Kwak and Kim. When the memoir publishes in Japan, the president reprimands Kim. Kim executes a mission that proves his loyalty to the president, but the president's trust falters more.

programme.title: A Man of Reason [English Dub]
programme.desc: After 10 years in the prison on behalf of his boss, Soo-hyuk is released, but the boss doubts his loyalty. When Soo-hyuk visits his long-abandoned girlfriend, he finds out that he, now, is a father of young girl. He wants to cut ties with the gang, but the boss is not ready to release him, and hires a notorious killer. The killer takes the daughter as hostage, and Soo-hyuk decides to take revenge in a way that he's best at; violence.

programme.title: The Divine Fury [English Dub]
programme.desc: Champion fighter Yong-hu seeks aid from a priest when strange wounds appear on his palms, leading to a battle against evil.

programme.title: HARBIN [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In 1909, a Korean freedom fighter plots to assassinate Japan's prime minister on a train journey to Harbin, seeking redemption for his fallen squad.

programme.title: Lost In Thailand [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The film is about three Chinese men traveling in Thailand: two competing scientists searching for their boss, and a tourist eager to explore the country.

programme.title: KUNG FU KILLER [English Dub]
programme.desc: A martial arts instructor from the police force gets imprisoned after killing a man by accident. But when a vicious killer starts targeting martial arts masters, the instructor offers to help the police in return for his freedom.

programme.title: Escape from the 21st Century [English Dub]
programme.desc: The story follows three friends who discover they have the power to travel back and forth 20 years with a sneeze. However, the future is not as good as they hoped, and they need to take on the responsibility of saving the world.

programme.title: FLASH POINT [English Dub]
programme.desc: Detective Sergeant Ma Jun, known for dispensing his own brand of justice during arrests, teams up with an undercover cop, Wilson, to try and bring down three merciless Vietnamese brothers running a smuggling ring in the months before mainland China's takeover of Hong Kong. Jun pursues the gang tirelessly, sometimes ignoring police protocols. A showdown is inevitable!

programme.title: Exhuma [English Dub]
programme.desc: Feng shui master Kim Sang-deok joins a shaman and a mortician to relocate a cursed ancestral grave, but the excavation unearths a colonial atrocity buried beneath the soil, forcing crew into a brutal confrontation with an immortal warrior.

programme.title: Mojin: The Lost Legend [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Three grave robbers (Chen Kun, Shu Qi, Huang Bo) explore a lost underground kingdom to find a powerful charm.

programme.title: Rampant [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Returning from imprisonment, a prince and his fellow countrymen band together to battle bloodthirsty demons.

programme.title: SAKURAN [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A young girl is sold into a red-light district brothel and tries to adapt to life and meke her own way as an No.1 oiran (courtesan).

programme.title: Gangnam Zombie [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Citizens from upscale Gangnam in Seoul start experiencing unusual and terrifying symptoms, devolving into inhuman creatures, leaving only a few survivors with the possibility to make it out alive.

programme.title: Be With You [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Soo-ah, who died, leaving an impossible that she’d come back when it rains, appears before Woo-jin one summer day drenched in the first rain of the monsoon season. While she doesn’t even remember him, Woo-jin is happy that she’s by his side again. As Woo-jin tells Soo-ah about their love story, the two lovers fall in love with each other all over again.

programme.title: 12.12: The Day [English Dub]
programme.desc: The movie depicts the events that occurred on the night that changed the course of South Korea's history. Following the assassination of President Park Chung-hee on October 26, 1979, the citizens of Seoul had high aspirations for the democratization of their country. However, on December 12, Army Commander Jeon Doo-kwang and his allies staged a coup to seize power. The remaining army forces, led by Capital Defense Commander Lee Tae-shin, engaged in a confrontation with the rebels, putting the fate of the country and the lives of its citizens at stake.

programme.title: Hard Hit [English Dub]
programme.desc: On his way to work, a bank manager receives an anonymous call claiming there's a bomb under his car seat, and if anyone exits the car, it will explode unless he can pay a ransom.

programme.title: ESCAPE [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Military camps near the DMZ of a divided land, where the South is the land of freedom, and the opposite side is the land of repression. Sergeant Gyu-nam, who has been planning an escape to the South for a long time, gets caught while stopping a common soldier, Dong-hyuk, from escaping. At the risk of execution, State Security Department Major Hyun-sang recognizes Gyu-nam from childhood. Instead of accusing him, Hyeon-sang decides to make Gyu-nam a hero who caught a deserter. Hyeon-sang, therefore, has succeeded in securing his performance records by saving Gyu-nam’s life. Nevertheless, Gyu-nam wants to live his life by his own will, not the government’s commands. He never gives up on crossing the border. On the other hand, Hyeon-sang desperately stops Gyu-nam to protect his life, which has been built by giving up his dream.

programme.title: Project Y [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Two women, friends and of the same age Mi Seon and Do Gyeong, might be used to struggling in the most dangerous part of Seoul's Gangnam district, but that doesn't mean they've settled into it. With no one but each other to rely on, the two friends grind away to save the money needed to leave their dangerous lifestyles behind. But just as “retirement” comes within reach, the world betrays them, shattering their hopes. On the edge of a dead end, they discover a hidden fortune of dirty cash and gold in Gangnam – and place all their bets on one final high-stakes gamble of a lifetime. They make an audacious plan to steal $6 million USD in gold bars and flee from the area.

programme.title: Hit and Run Squad [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The internal Affairs team has been disgraced while investigating a bribery case against the Police Commissioner and racer-turned-entrepreneur Jung Jae-chul. The second-in-command of the IA team, Lieutenant Eun Shi-yeon, is relegated to the Hit and Run Squad at Inchon PD. She meets Squad Captain Woo and constable Seo Min-jae, who has an instinct for cars and a delinquent past. Eun also gets acquainted with Seo's family, who have met through car accidents. A hit-and-run case leads the squad to Jung as a prime suspect, Eun conducts a separate operation to acquire the black box in Jung's concept car. Jung, a reckless speed freak, chases Eun, leading to a tragic accident costing someone's life. When Eun discovers the dirty deal behind her back, she cooperates with Seo to finally bring justice to Jung.

programme.title: TAI CHI ZERO [English Dub]
programme.desc: Yang travels to Chen Village to learn a powerful form of Tai Chi. Though villagers are forbidden from teaching outsiders, Yang becomes their best hope for survival when a man arrives with a plan to build a railroad through the village.

programme.title: TAI CHI HERO [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tai Chi Hero is a martial arts adventure story about a martial artist defending his adopted home and marriage while mastering the art of Tai Chi. Starring Jayden Yuan, Angelababy, Eddie Peng. Continuing his journey, Yang Lu Chan marries into the Chen family to learn advanced Tai Chi. Soon, he must overcome internal village suspicion and lead the defense against a powerful army armed with deadly western technology.

programme.title: Ransomed [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In 1987, a diplomat who had disappeared in Lebanon 20 months earlier sent a coded message announcing his survival. Min-joon, a diplomat in charge of Middle East affairs, volunteered for an unofficial operation to rescue his colleague, hoping to be posted to the United States if successful. After arriving at the airport, Min-joon got into the car of Pan-soo, a Korean taxi driver, to evade airport security who were trying to steal a ransom. He was chased by corrupt officials and gangs who were looking for money and didn't fully trust his only ally. Will Min-joon be able to complete the mission safely?
